items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1962-08-26
items.q: Teddy Farrar played with us sometimes on a ukulele called the Terror Patch

ctx.x: player, you know. You want to go into that Invincibles now,

who else was in the group, and when they... Well, that, of course, that was around 1917 or 1918. No, time of the First World War. Yeah, it was around 1917 or 18 years old. 16 or 1917 or something like that. Did you finish school? Oh, well, I was going off and on to school whenever I could get to it. My father died when I was 15, you know, and that meant I had a young brother seven years old and a mother, and between us two, we kept my brother in school, and I was in and out of school whenever I could get it.
